confidence_notes: I based the restaurant, coffee and beer anchors on web search results that summarized crowd-sourced cost-of-living data from 2026. These included Numbeo figures from June 2026 (inexpensive meal about $25, mid-range meal for two about $110, domestic draft beer about $8), MyLifeElsewhere (cappuccino about $5.36, pint about $8) and GoWira (bar beer about $10, cafe coffee about $5). I nudged beer and the meal prices up slightly for downtown and tourist areas in July 2026. My searches did not check cocktail or wine prices. Those two anchors use typical Boston bar prices and their usual ratio to beer, so they are less certain. Accommodation anchors are model estimates for July peak season from general knowledge only. I did not check live listings. Boston has very few registered hostels and almost no true 1-star hotels, so hostel_private_2p and hotel_1star_2p are especially uncertain. The RBA exchange rate came from a web search result summarizing the RBA 4pm rate for 18 November 2026 (0.6720 USD per AUD). I did not read the rba.gov.au page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Prices in high-cost US Northeast cities such as New York and Washington DC, adjusted to Boston's slightly lower food and drink prices and its tight, expensive summer hotel market.
